policy: One arm-blind standard judges exact final-text grammar, coherence, scientific quality and fidelity to the public source. Anchor claim preservation is a separate axis and does not redefine intrinsic approval. Material garbling, unsupported causal changes and public-source claim deletions fail. Uncertain is unapproved. No silent repair; no arm inference. This is individual review, not a judge-accuracy estimate or correctness certificate.

G1.finding: Cambridge treats procedure as countable or uncountable, while its determiner guidance distinguishes singular count-noun uses. That prevents declaring every bare such procedure categorically ungrammatical. The exact anaphoric use remains a language-quality uncertainty, not a scientific rejection.
